ns2:course.label: Clinical Practice II
ns2:course.description: Teaches in greater depth the clinical skills, practices, and procedures used in the Veterinary Teaching Hospital and the Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory and provides hands-on exposure to the methodologies used to diagnose, treat, and prevent disease in animals. Approved for S/U grading. Prerequisite: VM 601, VM 605, and good standing in the veterinary professional curriculum, or consent of instructor.
